cd /testbed && git apply --recount <<'PATCH'
diff --git a/include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp b/include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp
--- a/include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp
+++ b/include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp
@@ -15,1 +15,1 @@
-#include <type_traits> // is_same, is_constructible, is_floating_point, is_enum, underlying_type
+#include <type_traits> // is_same, is_constructible, is_floating_point, is_enum, is_unsigned, underlying_type
@@ -320,5 +320,6 @@
 inline void to_json(BasicJsonType& j, EnumType e) noexcept
 {
     using underlying_type = typename std::underlying_type<EnumType>::type;
-    external_constructor<value_t::number_integer>::construct(j, static_cast<underlying_type>(e));
+    constexpr value_t type = std::is_unsigned<underlying_type>::value ? value_t::number_unsigned : value_t::number_integer;
+    external_constructor<type>::construct(j, static_cast<underlying_type>(e));
 }
diff --git a/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/enum_conversion.md b/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/enum_conversion.md
--- a/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/enum_conversion.md
+++ b/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/enum_conversion.md
@@ -1,8 +1,9 @@
 # Specializing enum conversion
 
-By default, enum values are serialized to JSON as integers. In some cases this could result in undesired behavior. If an
-enum is modified or re-ordered after data has been serialized to JSON, the later de-serialized JSON data may be
-undefined or a different enum value than was originally intended.
+By default, enum values are serialized to JSON as integers, with signedness matching the enum's underlying type.
+In some cases this could result in undesired behavior. If an enum is modified or re-ordered after data has been
+serialized to JSON, the later de-serialized JSON data may be undefined or a different enum value than was originally
+intended.
 
 It is possible to more precisely specify how a given enum is mapped to and from JSON as shown below:
PATCH
python3 tools/amalgamate/amalgamate.py -c tools/amalgamate/config_json.json -s . --verbose=no && git --no-pager diff --stat && cd build && make -s test-conversions_cpp11 test-udt_cpp11 && ./tests/test-conversions_cpp11 && ./tests/test-udt_cpp11

cd /testbed && git --no-pager diff -- single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp | head -150 && command -v astyle; command -v clang-format; sed -n '10,18p' include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp && sed -n '316,328p' include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp

cd /testbed && find tests/src -name '*enum*' -o -name '*udt*' && ls build/tests/test-conversions* build/tests/test-udt* && sed -n '1,180p' tools/amalgamate/config_json.json && grep -nE 'astyle|pretty' .clang-format .github/workflows/*.yml | head -30

cd /testbed && c++ -std=c++20 -DDOCTEST_CONFIG_SUPER_FAST_ASSERTS -DJSON_TEST_KEEP_MACROS -DJSON_TEST_USING_MULTIPLE_HEADERS=0 -Itests/thirdparty/doctest -Itests/thirdparty/fifo_map -Ibuild/include -Isingle_include tests/src/unit-conversions.cpp build/tests/CMakeFiles/test_main.dir/src/unit.cpp.o -o build/test-enum-single-header && ./build/test-enum-single-header && rm build/test-enum-single-header build/enum-generated.patch build/enum-cmake.log

cd /testbed && git diff --check && git --no-pager diff -- include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp tests/src/unit-conversions.cpp docs/mkdocs/docs/features/enum_conversion.md && git --no-pager status --short
